verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime is an API-first platform, so it runs headlessly by design. Every request is authenticated non-interactively with API key ID/secret via HTTP Basic Auth. A free Developer Sandbox isolated from production data supports automated testing, and the docs explicitly mention testing from the command line. Webhooks support event-driven automation. Missing for 10: an official CLI or SDK, CI-specific guidance or examples, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probe found none), and independent hands-on corroboration.
